title: Triggers: an optional name, all or ticked terminals, the new 'send to' wording, edit in the row, and saved across restarts
story: Triggers under the Injector now have an optional name and can watch every terminal, including ones opened later, or only the ticked ones. The form now reads 'When a terminal reaches N% context, send the message to only that terminal | every terminal it watches', and 'only that terminal' replaces the old default 'all watched terminals'. Each row has edit and delete buttons, a clickable watched-terminals pill instead of a written list of names, and 'Not fired yet' until it fires. Triggers now survive a restart, where before they were lost; ticked ones come back watching nothing.

checks.criterion: An unnamed trigger shows the message's first words as its name
checks.steps: Open the Injector panel. In Triggers leave Name empty, pick 'All terminals, also new ones', type 'Stop and write a handoff note now' and click '+ Add trigger'.
checks.expected: A new row titled 'Stop and write a…' reading 'At 80% → only that terminal'.

checks.criterion: An 'all terminals' trigger also watches a terminal opened after it was made
checks.steps: Add a trigger at 5% with 'All terminals, also new ones' and message 'echo hello'. Open a new Claude terminal and let its context pass 5%.
checks.expected: 'echo hello' is typed into the new terminal, its header shows the amber message icon, and the row reads 'Last fired HH:MM by <that terminal>: sent to 1'.

checks.criterion: 'Only that terminal' sends to the terminal that reached the percent; 'every terminal it watches' sends to all
checks.steps: Open terminals A and B and tick both. Add trigger 1 (only that terminal, 5%) and trigger 2 (every terminal it watches, 5%) with different messages. Let only A pass 5%.
checks.expected: Trigger 1's message reaches A only; trigger 2's reaches A and B.

checks.criterion: Edit, Save and Cancel change or keep the trigger; the pill lists watched terminals
checks.steps: Tick two terminals and add a trigger named 'Compact'. Click the '2 terminals' pill. Click the pencil, change the name, click Cancel. Click the pencil, set 65 and Save.
checks.expected: The pill lists both as 'name · project'; Cancel keeps 'Compact'; Save shows 'At 65% → only that terminal'.

checks.criterion: After a restart every trigger is back and re-armed; a ticked one with no terminals shows 'watches nothing'
checks.steps: Add one 'all terminals' trigger and one ticked trigger. Quit Maestro and start it again.
checks.expected: Both rows are back reading 'Not fired yet'; the ticked one reads 'watches nothing, edit to pick terminals'; the all-terminals one fires again for a terminal passing its percent.
